errata.error: UHSLC stamps its Hong Kong (Quarry Bay) hourly heights an hour early in every version and the fast-delivery series: the height labeled T was measured at T + 1 h UTC ([openwatersio/slackwater-database#360](https://github.com/openwatersio/slackwater-database/issues/360), confirmed by the clock check).
errata.response: Every value is moved an hour later.
errata.evidence: Found in [openwatersio/slackwater-database#360](https://github.com/openwatersio/slackwater-database/issues/360) and confirmed by `scripts/clock-check.ts`: Quarry Bay fits other records best an hour later, in every version and the fast-delivery series.

errata.error: UHSLC's station metadata places six series several kilometers from their gauge, one of them in the open sea.
errata.response: The station refresh moves each station to the gauge's position from another source, listed in `POSITIONS` in `src/positions.ts`. An entry applies only while UHSLC still serves the position it was written against; if UHSLC moves the station, it keeps UHSLC's position and the refresh reports the entry and fails the run until a person checks it.
errata.evidence:
| Station | UHSLC | Gauge | Off by | Source of the gauge's position |
| --- | --- | --- | --: | --- |
| Port Stanley 290A, 1964–1974 | -52.7, -57.8667 | -51.690339, -57.864931 | 112 km | PSMSL Stanley (1082), 1964–1974 |
| Port Stanley 290, 1992 on | -51.75, -57.9333 | -51.692358, -57.820514 | 10 km | PSMSL Stanley II (1796), 1992 on |
| Meulaboh 914 | 4.316667, 96.21667 | 4.1274865, 96.131854 | 23 km | IOC sea level monitoring (meul) |
| Acapulco 316 | 16.8417, -99.8517 | 16.8379333, -99.903 | 5.5 km | IOC (acap2); UHSLC's own 316A and 316B, and UNAM's records, are within 1 km of it |
| Kaumalapau 548 | 20.78, -156.9 | 20.79, -156.995 | 10 km | CO-OPS Kaumalapau Harbor (1614465); UHSLC's position is inland on Lanai |
| Chuuk 054A, 1947–1991 | 7.45368, 151.8982 | 7.44667, 151.847 | 5.7 km | NOAA's Moen Island gauge (CO-OPS 1840000); UHSLC's position is its current gauge's |

UHSLC's 290A position sits 112 km south of Stanley in the South Atlantic. slackwater-database tracks the same positions in TICON's copies of these series in [openwatersio/slackwater-database#375](https://github.com/openwatersio/slackwater-database/issues/375).

errata.error: UHSLC's Esperanza research-quality levels before 31 August 1998 are on a zero 3.3 m from the record's later one.
errata.response: Values before 31 August 1998 are flagged `suspect`, keeping UHSLC's own flag as `source_flag`.
errata.evidence: Found by running GESLA's datum-jump rule (`datumJumps` in `src/sources/gesla`, a 30-day median shift of more than 0.75 m) over every record the lake lists as coastal, and confirmed, November 2026, by daily-mean differences against GESLA's copy of UHSLC's fast-delivery Esperanza record (`gesla/esperanza-601-arg-uhslc_fd`), which keeps one zero throughout: the series less it is −3.29 m before the date and 0.0 after.

errata.error: UHSLC's Qaqortoq levels from June 2008 on are on a zero about 5 m from the record's earlier one, with no change of datum marked.
errata.response: The lake keeps the values as served: the lake holds no independent record of the gauge to show which zero is wrong, so nothing is flagged.
errata.evidence: Found by running GESLA's datum-jump rule (`datumJumps` in `src/sources/gesla`) over every record the lake lists as coastal, November 2026; the lake holds no other record of the gauge or gauge nearby to compare, so this rests on the record's own medians. Yearly medians are 1.59 to 1.81 m from 1991 to 1998 and 6.74 to 6.81 m from 2008 on, across a gap from 1999 to 2007. No other gauge in the lake lies within 150 km; GESLA's copies hold the same values.

errata.error: UHSLC's Gibraltar levels from November 2023 on read about 1.5 m higher than the record's earlier ones, with no change of datum marked.
errata.response: The lake keeps the values as served: the lake holds no independent record of the gauge to show which zero is wrong, so nothing is flagged. A datum epoch for the record is planned.
errata.evidence: Found by running GESLA's datum-jump rule (`datumJumps` in `src/sources/gesla`) over every record the lake lists as coastal, November 2026; no gauge in the lake spans the 2001 to 2022 gap, so this rests on the record's own medians. Yearly medians are 0.60 to 0.67 m from 1993 to 2000 and 2.07 to 2.10 m from 2023 on. The record joins UHSLC's research-quality version B (1993 to 2000) to its fast-delivery series from November 2023, which TICON's matching places 1.8 km from version B's position, so the later series may be a relocated gauge with its own zero.
